response.sql: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.healtheval AS status, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.healtheval), mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg FROM site_groups) SELECT g.site_code, g.status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - m.mean_avg AS excess FROM site_groups g CROSS JOIN mean_calc m WHERE g.avg_ratio > m.mean_avg ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
